notes: packages/gameplay/src/index.ts is parent-owned, so the new modules are not re-exported from the package root yet. At merge add: export * from './inventory' and export * from './crafting'.
Export names were picked to avoid collisions with the existing blockEntities barrel: StackLimitResolver (vs MaxStackResolver) and cloneItemStack (vs cloneStack).

Inventory: 36 slots (9 hotbar + 27 main) from INVENTORY, stack limits from ITEMS.maxStackOf (tools 1), stacks merge only when item id and damage match, tool damage destroys the stack once durability is exceeded, and GAME_MODE.Creative consumes neither items nor durability.

Crafting: RecipeRegistry implementation over 53 recipes (37 shaped, 4 shapeless, 12 smelting), covering planks, stick, crafting table, furnace, chest, all 16 tool tier/class combinations, torch, door, bed and the redstone family (lamp, lever, button, pressure plate, piston). Shaped matching is translation invariant via bounding-box normalization, shapeless matching is order independent and multiset exact, and matchCrafting handles both 2x2 and 3x3 grids.

Furnace: tickFurnace is a pure function over FurnaceData. Cook progress is frozen (never decayed) while fuel is exhausted or the output slot is blocked, so interrupt plus resume equals one long tick; removing the input resets progress. Fuel is only lit when a smeltable input is present and the output can accept the result, and output stacks accumulate up to the registry stack limit.
canHarvestWith / breakTimeWith wrap the contract canHarvest / breakTimeSeconds helpers, so no contract change was needed.
pnpm build regenerates packages/assets-gen/generated and dist/, which are ignored; git status is clean at head_sha.
This report file is added by a follow-up commit on top of head_sha and contains no source changes.
